constraints.description: Generated artifacts must be reconciled by the named parent-phase owner before certification, commit, or push.

validation.validation_method: Confirm the change names reconcile-kbd-control-plane-projections and does not claim distribution certification.

constraints.description: No committed secrets may be introduced by the change.

validation.validation_method: Inspect every changed registry-prune source, integration, documentation, and OpenSpec surface for credential material.

constraints.description: Operator documentation and exhaustive CLI references must match the new command surface.

validation.validation_method: Compare documented commands with the clap hierarchy and apply authority constraint.

constraints.description: Generator behavior must remain idempotent and generated plugin surfaces must not be hand-edited.

validation.validation_method: Confirm this change does not alter a generator or generated plugin surface; retain the parent reconciliation gate.

constraints.description: Launchd-reachable shell scripts must remain compatible with macOS Bash 3.2.

validation.validation_method: Confirm the change modifies no launchd-reachable shell script.

constraints.description: Dry run is byte-immutable; apply re-evaluates under lock, preserves runtime history and valid registrations, writes rollback evidence before mutation, and is idempotent.

validation.validation_method: Inspect the implementation and require the two external runtime scenarios plus the external CLI binary scenario to pass.

global_rules: No parent-phase certification, commit, or push before projection reconciliation
termination_conditions: The QA report exists and the artifact manifest validates
